source: NaF heat-pulse line, second-sound velocity vs temperature
quantity_to_extract: measured second-sound velocity against temperature and the normal-process relaxation time or the frequency at which the second-sound response rolls off
conversion_to_relaxation_time: tau = 1/omega_roll where omega_roll is the angular frequency at which the measured second-sound response starts to roll off; if the paper quotes tau_N directly, use the quoted value and its stated fit
uncertainty_handling: take the error bar the paper prints on c2; if tau is obtained from a roll-off frequency quoted with a range, propagate that range as a symmetric interval and state that it is an interval, not a standard deviation
where_to_look: the section that plots c2 against T and the paragraph that defines the normal-process lifetime
